description: Confirm mature vs precursor numbering, map CBG deficiency variants onto the pocket, plot cortisol contact distances
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict

rec = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P08185.json", timeout=60).json()
seq = rec["sequence"]["value"]
OFF = 22  # signal peptide 1-22 -> mature numbering = precursor - 22

print("Numbering check (PDB/literature use MATURE numbering = UniProt precursor - 22):")
for pdbnum, expect in [(232,'Q'),(260,'R'),(264,'N'),(368,'H'),(371,'W'),(367,'D'),(238,'N'),(347,'N'),(345,'T'),(344,'V'),(334,'E')]:
    up = pdbnum + OFF
    print(f"  mature {expect}{pdbnum}  ->  UniProt {seq[up-1]}{up}   match={seq[up-1]==expect}")

print("\nUniProt N-glycosylation sites (precursor -> mature):")
glyc=[f["location"]["start"]["value"] for f in rec["features"] if f["type"]=="Glycosylation"]
for g in glyc: print(f"   N{g} (precursor) = N{g-OFF} (mature)")

print("\nUniProt natural variants (precursor -> mature):")
for f in rec["features"]:
    if f["type"]=="Natural variant":
        p = f["location"]["start"]["value"]
        print(f"   {f.get('alternativeSequence',{}).get('originalSequence','?')}{p}"
              f"->{''.join(f.get('alternativeSequence',{}).get('alternativeSequences',['?']))} "
              f"(precursor) = position {p-OFF} mature | {f.get('description','')}")

# ---- Pocket geometry from 4C49 (cortisol, highest completeness) ----
def parse(txt):
    out=[]
    for ln in txt.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")):
            out.append((ln[:6].strip(), ln[12:16].strip(), ln[17:20].strip(), ln[21],
                        int(ln[22:26]), float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54])))
    return out
AA3 = {'ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL'}
atoms = parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4C49.pdb", timeout=120).text)
lig = [a for a in atoms if a[2]=="HCY" and a[3]=="A"]
L = np.array([a[5:8] for a in lig])
prot=[a for a in atoms if a[2] in AA3 and a[3]=="A"]
P=np.array([a[5:8] for a in prot])
mind = np.sqrt(((P[:,None,:]-L[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min(1)
cont=defaultdict(lambda:9e9)
for a,d in zip(prot,mind):
    if d<5.0: cont[(a[4],a[2])]=min(cont[(a[4],a[2])],d)
items=sorted(cont.items())
labels=[f"{r.capitalize()}{n}" for (n,r),_ in items]
dists=[d for _,d in items]
nums=[n for (n,r),_ in items]

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.6))
cols=['#c0392b' if n in (367,) else ('#2980b9' if n==371 else '#7f8c8d') for n in nums]
ax.bar(range(len(dists)), dists, color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(labels))); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=55, ha='right')
ax.set_ylabel("Minimum distance to cortisol (A)")
ax.set_title("Human CBG steroid-binding pocket, PDB 4C49 (cleaved CBG + cortisol, 2.7 A)\nmature-protein numbering; red = CBG Lyon site Asp367, blue = Trp371")
ax.axhline(4.0, ls='--', c='k', lw=0.8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nPocket residues within 5 A of cortisol (mature numbering):", labels)
